$comment: The seven goal-driven patterns every product needs (framework 09 section 7). `families` is the family sequence of the typical composition, used for nearest-pattern matching; `components` are the canonical component names it is assembled from.

patterns.name: Form / data entry
patterns.composition: Form -> Inputs/Selects/Checkboxes -> one primary Button -> inline Alert on error

patterns.name: Master-detail
patterns.composition: List/Table (master) -> Sheet or panel (detail) -> contextual Toolbar

patterns.name: Dashboard
patterns.composition: Card grid -> Badge/Meter/Progress -> Skeleton on load -> Empty state when no data

patterns.name: Wizard / multi-step
patterns.composition: Stepper (position) -> Form per step -> Progress (single task) -> Toast/Alert on completion

patterns.name: The async triad
patterns.composition: Skeleton/Spinner (loading) -> content -> Empty state (no data) -> Alert (error)

patterns.name: Confirmation
patterns.composition: Action -> Alert Dialog (irreversible) or Toast + Undo (reversible)

patterns.name: Filtering
patterns.composition: Search/Combobox -> Chips (active filters, removable) -> Toolbar -> results Table
